rows.role_title: President of the Indian National Congress
rows.text: At the AICC briefing of 17 October 2022, Central Election Authority chairman Madhusudan Mistry says (Hindi) 'आज का दिन, पूरे देश के अंदर चुनाव का दिन था' (today was election day across the country), that about 9,500 of about 9,900 delegates had voted, about 96 per cent on provisional figures, and that 87 had voted at the AICC booth.
